about.content_title:
At Shop Kloset, we aim to bring out people's hidden potential and create a richer life.
We will spare no effort to create a world full of smiles for all people,
and create a Japanese society overflowing with possibilities.
about.vision_comments: Through apps and people, we enrich each person's life by addressing various modern challenges.
about.value_comments:
To build a better society where people and all living things can find happiness,
we will not rest on past achievements, we will not compromise, we will always look one step ahead, take action, and realize this vision.

business.layout_title:
We use the power of words we have cultivated to
maximize people's potential.
business.content_title:
Rapid advances in technology have made the world more convenient.
However, it is also true that the number of people suffering from mental fatigue is increasing.
We will continue to take on every challenge to help people achieve mental stability and live lives that bring smiles to their faces every day.

business.comments_list_1: Driven by our desire to support models who want to fulfill their dreams or who once gave up on them, Shop Kloset has established the Fairy Models Agency business to help support their modeling dreams.
business.comments_list_2: Through Fairy Models Agency, we support not only models in Japan, but also overseas models looking to work in Japan.
